paper.title_en: Direct Urca process facilitated by non-Fermi-liquid quantum criticality
paper.abstract_en: Conventional Fermi-liquid theories of dense nuclear matter predict that the direct Urca process requires a proton fraction above a threshold of $Y_p \approx 0.11$--$0.15$, which is rarely reached in low-mass neutron stars. Here we show that this stringent kinematic constraint is drastically relaxed by the non-Fermi liquid behavior arising from superfluid and superconducting quantum criticality in neutron stars. In the non-Fermi-liquid regimes, nucleons have a smooth momentum occupation without a sharp Fermi surface, and their chemical potentials develop a logarithmic temperature dependence. These intrinsic features fundamentally alter the standard $β$-equilibrium relation. Consequently, direct Urca neutrino emission can be activated even at low nuclear densities. This modifies the long-standing Urca-threshold paradigm and indicates that direct Urca process has the opportunity to occur in low-mass neutron stars.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文聚焦非费米液体量子临界性如何改变中子星物质的β平衡与直接Urca过程阈值，涉及非费米液体与量子临界等凝聚态与强关联物理核心概念，理论深度较好且对传统Urca阈值范式提出修正，值得进一步阅读；但仅两天的预印本且无引用，引用信号保持中性。
decision.title_zh: 非费米液体量子临界性促进的直接Urca过程
decision.abstract_zh: 传统的稠密核物质费米液体理论预言，直接Urca过程要求质子分数高于阈值 $Y_p \approx 0.11$--$0.15$，而这一条件在低质量中子星中很少能达到。本文表明，中子星中超流与超导量子临界性所导致的非费米液体行为会大幅放宽这一严格的运动学约束。在非费米液体区间，核子具有平滑的动量占据而无尖锐的费米面，其化学势呈现出对温度的对数依赖。这些内禀特征从根本上改变了标准的 $β$ 平衡关系。因此，即使在低核密度下也能激活直接Urca中微子发射。这修正了长期存在的Urca阈值范式，并表明直接Urca过程有机会在低质量中子星中发生。
